user.title: Connect Apple Push
user.description: Create an APNs key in your Apple Developer account (Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys, with Apple Push Notifications enabled), then paste the whole .p8 file here. The key is checked with Apple before it is saved.

data_description.key: Everything from -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- to -----END PRIVATE KEY-----.
data_description.key_id: The 10-character ID shown next to the key.
data_description.team_id: The 10-character ID in the top right of your developer account.
data_description.bundle_id: Leave as com.sfenton.home unless the app's bundle ID changes.

error.invalid_key: That isn't an APNs key. Paste the full contents of the .p8 file.
error.key_rejected: Apple rejected the key. Check the Key ID and Team ID, and that the key has Apple Push Notifications enabled.
error.bundle_rejected: Apple accepted the key but not for this bundle ID. Check that push is enabled for the app ID.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Apple's push service. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: Push is already set up for this app.

data_description.critical_alerts: Turn on only after Apple grants the app the Critical Alerts entitlement. Until then, critical notifications arrive as time-sensitive.
data_description.push_base_url: Where Home Assistant can reach itself, such as http://127.0.0.1:8123. Leave empty to use the internal URL. The app picks up a change the next time it opens.
